verdict.rationale: Self-serve document automation is a fair question for a law firm serving founders, so the axis applies. The evidence pack shows only traditional advisory practice pages (PE, M&A, ESOP, privacy) and publications. There is no interactive document assembly, online template completion, or self-serve tool.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm ships self-serve document automation — interactive assembly of real legal documents I can complete online, not just static templates
